name: Transformer envelope
summary: A generic transformer object for locating the equipment and its documented interfaces.
description: A transformer envelope connects a GA placement to a selected transformer and its manufacturer drawing. The physical information can include connection locations, accessories and maintenance or installation requirements, all of which depend on the product and application.

The original envelope illustration is unscaled and has no manufacturer dimensions. Follow the cited public resources to the exact product, then use its current drawing and installation information for engineering work.
readingNotes: Distinguish the equipment envelope from any separately documented access area.
Use the actual manufacturer view and reference orientation.
drawingChecklist: Link ratings to the equipment schedule.
distinction: An SLD transformer symbol is not a scaled footprint. A generic envelope has no model-specific dimensions.
